Check out the answers to all the relevant SharePoint Consulting queries you might have. What does a SharePoint consultant do? A SharePoint consultant helps in planning, implementing, optimizing, and maintaining SharePoint environments. Their work involves evaluating business requirements, setting up SharePoint to enhance collaboration and document management, tailoring workflows, implementing security compliance, training employees, and resolving problems. In essence, they offer SharePoint consulting to support your business goals! Why should I hire a SharePoint consulting firm? Engaging a SharePoint consulting company provides you with the benefit of skilled SharePoint consulting experts who can: Speed up deployment and reduce errors Tailor SharePoint to fit your unique workflows Maintain a secure, scalable, and future-proof execution Offer support and training to your staff Perform migrations and upgrades with zero downtime What services for SharePoint does Awesome Technologies Inc. provide? Awesome Technology Inc. provides a full range of SharePoint services, such as: SharePoint planning and strategy Custom SharePoint development and integration Microsoft SharePoint Consulting Services Migration from legacy systems or other platforms Workflow automation and process optimization SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 integration Ongoing support and user training Can SharePoint be customized for my business needs? Yes, SharePoint is very customizable. It can be made to match to your very specific business processes, branding, and workflows. From custom web parts and templates to complex integrations with third-party systems and Power Platform, SharePoint does wonders! Can a SharePoint consultant help migrate my existing data to SharePoint? Yes, a SharePoint consultant can efficiently look after your data migration process. Whether you’re moving from file servers, dated intranets, Google Workspace, Dropbox, or other solutions, consultants at our SharePoint consulting company make the process safe and seamless. Indeed, our SharePoint consulting providers oversee everything from pre-migration planning and content audits to data mapping, migration, testing, and validation. The aim of our SharePoint experts is to keep downtime at a minimum, maintain data integrity, and configure your SharePoint environment for simple uptake and long-term success! How much does SharePoint consulting cost? The cost of SharePoint consulting depends on the complexity, timeline, and scope of your project. Hourly rates vary between $100 and $250, and smaller, simple projects can begin at $5,000 to $15,000. Mid-level executions with customization or automation can be between $15,000 and $50,000. However, enterprise-class projects with high-scale migrations or integrations can be above $50,000. Most consulting companies such as Awesome Technologies Inc. provide custom-priced bids based on a discovery session or need consultation.
